svg.title: Food Delivery Data Pipeline — AWS + Databricks
svg.desc: End-to-end pipeline flowchart from S3 file landing through Bronze, Silver, Gold layers to dashboards, with Databricks Workflows, DynamoDB audit, and SNS alerting.
svg.text: Food Delivery Pipeline — AWS S3 + Databricks + Delta Lake
